dedupe_keys.name: life superhero ventilated air permeable roof retrofit of social housing in reggio emilia climate adapt

description: This Climate-ADAPT case study documents a passive-cooling roof retrofit of two social housing blocks at Via G. Maramotti 23 and 25 in Reggio Emilia, Italy, built in 1984 and 1981 from prefabricated concrete panels and owned by the public housing agency ACER. Under the EU LIFE SUPERHERO project, which began on 1 July 2020, a pitched roof using HEROTILE interlocking clay tiles was installed over the existing flat roofs; the tiles let air pass through their joints to strengthen ventilation under the covering. Facade insulation and new windows came first, in 2023, and monitoring before and after the retrofit tracked roof temperatures, indoor comfort and occupants' energy use. Infrastructure costs were EUR 157,005 for both buildings, or EUR 320 to 356 per square metre. The project also fed ventilated roofs into Italy's green public procurement criteria and a GBC Italia passive roof cooling pilot credit. Coverage: two buildings, with local projections of summer maximum temperatures rising from 28.3 to 31.0 °C for 2021-2050. Access: the case study page, published on 3 July 2026 and modified on 11 September 2026, with links to project deliverables and a data sharing platform. Licence: Climate-ADAPT content under the EEA reuse policy; free. Caveats: results are summarised by the project team; monitoring data sit on the project platform. Simulation uses are calibrating roof and attic models for overheating studies and costing passive cooling retrofits. Related records: the Rouen Luciline and Torino 25 Verde case studies.
name: LIFE SUPERHERO ventilated, air-permeable roof retrofit of social housing in Reggio Emilia (Climate-ADAPT)
outcomes: A pitched roof with HEROTILE ventilated, air-permeable clay tiles was installed over the flat roofs of two 1980s social housing blocks after facade insulation and window replacement, and monitored across summers; infrastructure costs were EUR 157,005, or EUR 320 to 356 per square metre, and the design service life is about 50 years.
